title: Detailed bow tie
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Left wing of bow tie -->
  <path d="M8 32 Q4 50 8 68 L42 54 Q38 50 42 46 Z" fill="#ff3b5c" stroke="#ff7a90" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <!-- Left wing inner fold highlight -->
  <path d="M14 38 Q12 50 14 62 L36 52 Q33 50 36 48 Z" fill="#ff6b85"/>
  <!-- Right wing of bow tie -->
  <path d="M92 32 Q96 50 92 68 L58 54 Q62 50 58 46 Z" fill="#ff3b5c" stroke="#ff7a90" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <!-- Right wing inner fold highlight -->
  <path d="M86 38 Q88 50 86 62 L64 52 Q67 50 64 48 Z" fill="#ff6b85"/>
  <!-- Center knot -->
  <rect x="42" y="42" width="16" height="16" rx="4" fill="#d4002a" stroke="#ff7a90" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <!-- Knot highlight -->
  <rect x="45" y="45" width="10" height="10" rx="2.5" fill="#ff5c7a"/>
  <!-- Top left wing shading -->
  <path d="M8 32 Q20 34 42 46 L42 49 Q20 38 8 36 Z" fill="#e8002e" opacity="0.7"/>
  <!-- Bottom left wing shading -->
  <path d="M8 68 Q20 66 42 54 L42 51 Q20 62 8 64 Z" fill="#e8002e" opacity="0.7"/>
  <!-- Top right wing shading -->
  <path d="M92 32 Q80 34 58 46 L58 49 Q80 38 92 36 Z" fill="#e8002e" opacity="0.7"/>
  <!-- Bottom right wing shading -->
  <path d="M92 68 Q80 66 58 54 L58 51 Q80 62 92 64 Z" fill="#e8002e" opacity="0.7"/>
  <!-- Left wing decorative stripe -->
  <path d="M20 42 Q28 48 38 50" fill="none" stroke="#ff9db0" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M20 58 Q28 52 38 50" fill="none" stroke="#ff9db0" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Right wing decorative stripe -->
  <path d="M80 42 Q72 48 62 50" fill="none" stroke="#ff9db0" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M80 58 Q72 52 62 50" fill="none" stroke="#ff9db0" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Polka dots on left wing -->
  <circle cx="18" cy="44" r="1.8" fill="#ffffaa"/>
  <circle cx="26" cy="50" r="1.8" fill="#ffffaa"/>
  <circle cx="18" cy="56" r="1.8" fill="#ffffaa"/>
  <circle cx="32" cy="47" r="1.5" fill="#ffffaa"/>
  <circle cx="32" cy="53" r="1.5" fill="#ffffaa"/>
  <!-- Polka dots on right wing -->
  <circle cx="82" cy="44" r="1.8" fill="#ffffaa"/>
  <circle cx="74" cy="50" r="1.8" fill="#ffffaa"/>
  <circle cx="82" cy="56" r="1.8" fill="#ffffaa"/>
  <circle cx="68" cy="47" r="1.5" fill="#ffffaa"/>
  <circle cx="68" cy="53" r="1.5" fill="#ffffaa"/>
</svg>
